title: Elorian AI Launches Glimpse Visual Model Matching Astra at 17x Lower Cost
summary:
The new AI system dominates Gemini 3.8 Flash in real world vision workloads and is both smaller and cheaper than the Google competitor. Developed by Elorian AI, the Glimpse model matches or exceeds Astra on 5 of 12 multimodal benchmarks and reduces token prices by 17x. The development team built the tool using only hundreds of GPUs.

Glimpse utilizes a visual reasoning technique based on recurrent computation over latent internal representations and the orchestration of subagents using internal visual states. This removes the restriction of text-based chain-of-thought, allowing the AI to process dynamic scenes that move or change angles, which have previously caused frontier models to fail. Elorian AI has made the model available for free public trial.

selectedTweets.text:
We developed a model reaching frontier-level multimodal performance, matching or exceeding Astra on 5 of 12 benchmarks, all with 17x lower token prices. The model is smaller and cheaper than Gemini 3.8 Flash while dominating it in real world vision workloads.

We achieved this by inventing a technique for visual reasoning, where the model is no longer restricted to text chain-of-thought. Conditioned on visual tokens, Glimpse can perform recurrent computation over latent internal representations and can even orchestrate subagents that send messages over internal visual states.

Really proud of what our small team and only hundreds of GPUs could accomplish.
